name: Chateaubriand-Roasted Filet Steak
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Chateaubriand is cut from the most tender center portion of beef tenderloin — virtually zero gristle or connective tissue, making it the easiest steak cut to digest.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium at Triton's or Lumiere's with the crushed new potatoes (eat the soft insides, skip any skins) and mild red wine jus on the side. Ask to swap green beans for peeled carrots or extra mashed potatoes during a flare.
watchOuts: Potato skins on crushed new potatoes
Rich Béarnaise sauce if high fat triggers urgency
